firm_data.firm_description: Katz Chwat, P.C. is a firm providing integrated solutions for their client's tax, business, and estate planning needs. They represent individuals and small, closely-held and family-owned businesses.
notable_facts: The firm was started in 2017 by Neil D. Katz and Lara R. Chwat.
The firm moved to a new office at 175 Pinelawn Road, Suite 420, Melville, NY 11747.

email.subject: AI for Katz Chwat, P.C. - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Neil,

You built Katz Chwat around integrated tax, estate planning, and business transaction work for closely-held and family-owned businesses. That focus on depth over breadth is exactly where AI can amplify your team's impact without compromising the client relationships that drive your practice.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform designed for law firms handling complex work with lean teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us because we understand the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

With successful East Coast pilots complete, we're expanding regionally. I'd welcome the chance to stop by Melville and show you how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete effectively.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
